claims.claim: 4.6 million views during the first half of Brazil v Switzerland, 28 Nov 2022 (live on Casimiro's channel)
claims.note: Body: 4,6 milhões de visualizações às 13h28, durante o 1º tempo; published 28 Nov 2022.

claims.claim: Poder360 called it his second straight YouTube live record, after Marília Mendonça
claims.note: Source: '2º recorde consecutivo de live mais assistida do YouTube'; previous holder Marília Mendonça.

claims.claim: CazéTV ranked first in Tubefilter's global subscriber chart for the second week running
claims.note: Source: 'is #1 ... for the second week in a row'.

claims.claim: Casimiro Miguel, known as Cazé, is a journalist and streamer
claims.note: Source: 'é jornalista e streamer'.

claims.claim: Tubefilter calls him a Brazilian creator
claims.note: Source: 'the Brazilian creator (whose real name is Casimiro Miguel)'.

claims.claim: His Twitch channel is named casimito
claims.note: Page title 'casimito - Twitch'; the cached page showed no bio, so only the handle is supported.

claims.claim: Born in Rio de Janeiro in October 1993, no day; Canaltech is the only source found
claims.note: Source: 'Casimiro nasceu no Rio de Janeiro, em outubro de 1993.'

claims.claim: He studied journalism at university without finishing the course
claims.note: Source: 'estudou jornalismo na faculdade, mas não chegou a concluir o curso'.

claims.claim: Became widely known during the pandemic through reaction streams, playing FIFA and GTA
claims.note: Source: 'ficou amplamente conhecido durante a pandemia'; reaction streams; FIFA and GTA named.

claims.claim: 24 Jan 2022 stream of the exclusive pre-premiere of Netflix's Neymar: O Caos Perfeito, with a surprise appearance by Neymar, peak about 545,000 viewers
claims.note: Source: 'cerca de 545 mil pessoas'; 'Neymar Jr. apareceu de surpresa na live'; event on Monday 24th, article 25/01/2022.

claims.claim: Canaltech reported it as a Brazilian Twitch record for the largest overall broadcast (the record wording, not a history claim)
claims.note: Source: 'recorde da Twitch brasileira de maior transmissão geral'.

claims.claim: YouTube wanted him to leave Twitch and stream live on YouTube (early March 2022)
claims.note: Source: 'A ideia do YouTube é que o jornalista deixe a Twitch'; published 04/03/2022.

claims.claim: His lives reached more than 600,000 viewers connected at the same time
claims.note: Source: 'mais de 600 mil telespectadores conectados simultaneamente'.

claims.claim: Streams often run into the early morning, focused on football and reactions to YouTube videos
claims.note: Source: 'normalmente viram a madrugada, são focadas em futebol e reações a vídeos do YouTube'.

claims.claim: CazéTV was launched in November 2022 during the Qatar World Cup
claims.note: Source: 'A CazéTV foi lançada em novembro de 2022, durante a Copa do Mundo do Catar.'

claims.claim: Bloomberg Línea lists him as Influencer/Fundador of CazéTV (founder)
claims.note: Source header: 'Influencer/Fundador| CazéTV'.

claims.claim: The channel broadcast 22 matches of the tournament
claims.note: Source: '22 partidas do torneio'.

claims.claim: Poder360 body gives 4.6 million views; subtitle gives 4 million simultaneous accesses
claims.note: Subtitle: '4 milhões de acessos simultâneos'; body: '4,6 milhões de visualizações'.

claims.claim: Poder360 gave CazéTV 3.16 million subscribers and his personal channel 859,000, with no other date than publication
claims.note: Source: 'tem 3,16 milhões de inscritos' and '859 mil'; article dated 28 Nov 2022.

claims.claim: GQ Brasil named him Homem do Ano in the digital content category, November 2022; Metrópoles reported it on 3 November
claims.note: Source: 'Homem do Ano, na categoria Conteúdo Digital pela GQ Brasil'; dated 03/11/2022.

claims.claim: He had also won iBest's Twitcher do Ano and eSports Brasil's Personalidade do Ano, both for 2021
claims.note: Photo caption refers to 2021 awards: iBest 'Twitcher do Ano', eSports Brasil 'Personalidade do Ano'.

claims.claim: Canaltech named him Streamer of the Year at its sixth awards, article published March 2023
claims.note: Source: 'streamer do ano no 6º Prêmio Canaltech'; published 14/03/2023.

claims.claim: He told his mother he would work to retire both parents; he once thought he would not make it in life
claims.note: Quotes: 'Se prepara que eu vou trabalhar para aposentar vocês'; 'Tinha para mim que eu não ia dar certo na vida'.

claims.claim: TNH1 says CazéTV competed for audience with TV Globo during the 2026 World Cup
claims.note: Source: 'chegou a competir pela audiência contra a TV Globo no Mundial de 2026'.

claims.claim: Tubefilter chart for 29 June to 5 July 2026: CazéTV first, 2.9 million gained that week, 38.9 million total
claims.note: Source: week June 29 - July 5 2026; 2.9 million weekly; total 38,900,000.

claims.claim: CazéTV's broadcast of Brazil's knockout match against Japan reached 21.1 million concurrent viewers
claims.note: Source: 'concurrent live audience of 21.1 million viewers' for the Brazil vs Japan knockout broadcast.

claims.claim: On 9 Sep 2026 outlets reported Casimiro left direct administrative control of CazéTV after four years
claims.note: TNH1 'após quatro anos'; Bandab published 09/09/2026.

claims.claim: Operational control now passes to LiveMode, a sports rights management company
claims.note: Source: 'transferindo o controle operacional para a LiveMode, empresa especializada em gestão de direitos esportivos'.

claims.claim: LiveMode was founded by the creators of Esporte Interativo
claims.note: Source: 'fundada pelos criadores do canal Esporte Interativo'.

claims.claim: Casimiro remains a partner and continues as main presenter and ambassador
claims.note: Bandab: 'permanecer como sócio da holding ... principal apresentador e embaixador'; TNH1: 'permanece como sócio da holding'.

claims.claim: TNH1 describes the move as a strategic restructuring and gives no date for it
claims.note: Source: 'uma reestruturação estratégica'; no specific date given.

claims.claim: Bandab attributes the news to columnist Flávio Ricco of Portal Leo Dias
claims.note: Source: 'colunista Flávio Ricco, do Portal Leo Dias'.

claims.claim: In March 2022 Correio Braziliense said his clips channel had nearly 2 million subscribers and 582 million views
claims.note: Source: 'quase 2 milhões de inscritos e 582 milhões de visualizações'.

claims.claim: Tubefilter's 38.9 million total is from July 2026
claims.note: Chart for week ending 5 July 2026.

claims.claim: Summary and FAQ: Casimiro is 32 per a September 2026 report
claims.note: Source: 'aos 32 anos'.

valueNote: Reconciles conflicting Poder360 figures, dates each subscriber count to its channel and date, and gives the 2026 ownership change with the primary-language sources.
summary: Every checked claim matches the opened sources. The page cites a primary source (Twitch profile) for the handle and sources for all other facts.
